subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw accept a card-based iPhone Control tab redesign on top of the newer native-list Control UI, or keep the current native-list direction?
rationale: The patch is a default visual product change, current main has moved in a different native SwiftUI direction, and automation cannot choose the intended iOS Control design.

options.title: Require a rebased design proposal
options.body: Ask for a rebase onto current main, branded typography, real simulator proof, and then evaluate the card layout against the native-list direction.

options.title: Keep the native-list direction
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if maintainers decide the current SwiftUI List Control tab is the desired product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the card direction
options.body: Accept the product direction but require conflict resolution, OpenClawType typography, and before/after visual proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Require a rebased design proposal
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase onto current main, branded typography, real simulator proof, and then evaluate the card layout against the native-list direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most directly carried recent Control/Talk visual hierarchy work and is the best available routing candidate for the design-direction choice.
